programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: In Palm Desert, California, a café dishes out a rib melt and breakfast tarts; in Maui, Hawaii, a funky gluten-free spot makes full-flavored pizza and fish and chips; in Virginia Beach, a crazy Caribbean joint serves up jerk pork and mama's beef stew.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: This trip, Guy Fieri travels the country diving into some meaty masterpieces starting at a spot in Longmont, Colorado, that serves craft beer and primo pub grub like their piled-high poutine burger.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: In Seattle, Guy visits a joint smoking up ribs and dishing out brisket chili; in Wilmington, N.C., he visits a breakfast spot getting dirty with their biscuits; in Oakland, Calif., Guy visits a spot serving up fried chicken, oxtails and collards.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: A Lansing, Mich., food truck dishes out shrimp burgers and a unique potato popper; a Bosnian restaurant in Tucson, Ariz., fires up legit Eastern European specialties; a down-home Southern seafood spot cooks up clam chowder and fries up favorites.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Guy digs into everything from pretzels to paella; in Bozeman, Mont., a five-star take on breakfast with a Mexican pork masterpiece; in Little Rock, Ark., a microbrewery serves elevated pub grub; a Mediterranean-inspired restaurant serving up paella.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Guy dives into dishes with regional flavor; an East Coast-Texas deli mashup piling smoked meat sensations; a Creole spot serving gumbo and fried pork chops; a real-deal Mexican spot dishing out Michoacán specialties, like the blazing hot molcajete.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: In Wilmington, Del., there's a 1940s Italian family spot that's making beef braciole and meaty ravioli from scratch; a diner putting elevated spins on the French dip and meatloaf in San Diego; a Middle Eastern joint in El Paso, Texas.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: A Japanese-Hawaiian spot putting a quick spin on fish, burgers and burritos; a bakery cooking up Down Under comfort food like meat pies and sausage rolls; a funky joint serving international mashups like Pasta Chihuahua and an oxtail tostada.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Guy Fieri is loading up on all kinds of Latin on this trip; in Logan, Utah, a Salvadoran spot puttin' out pupusas and a cabeza creation.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Guy's digging into dishes from beef to buns and in Logan, Utah, a place is serving up worldwide flavor, like lomo saltado and a peanut butter burger.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: A sandwich shop serving up tastes of Peru in Hollywood, Fla.; a pierogi palace in Philadelphia giving a fresh take on Polish specialties; a wood-fired pizza spot putting its own spin on pies in Fargo, N.D.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: In California, Guy takes Marc Summers to check out fried rice in a bowl and burrito; then, he's off to Vegas with Hunter for real deal Jamaican and to Florida for lobster meatballs and pork cheek empanadas.
